title_en: Unpaid Wages, Delayed Salary & Final Settlement Dues: Labour Authority Claims
title_hi: बकाया वेतन, वेतन में देरी और गैरकानूनी कटौती: श्रम अधिकारी के समक्ष दावा

laws.plain_meaning: Every employer is responsible for payment of all wages required to be paid to employees. Wage period cannot exceed 1 month, and wages must be paid before expiry of 7th day (if under 1000 workers) or 10th day after the wage period.

laws.section: Section 15 (Claims Arising out of Deductions or Delay)
laws.plain_meaning: Application can be filed before the Authority appointed under Section 15 (Labour Commissioner / Assistant Labour Commissioner) for recovery of unpaid/delayed wages along with compensation up to 10 times the amount deducted, or up to Rs. 3,000 for delayed wages.

Employer must pay every employee wages at a rate not less than the statutory minimum rate of wages fixed by state/central notification without unauthorized deductions. Section 20 provides claims authority for recovery with compensation up to 10 times the shortfall.

Gratuity is payable on termination of employment after continuous service of not less than 5 years. Employer must determine and pay gratuity within 30 days of it becoming payable, with simple interest if delayed.

steps.action_en: Issue a formal written demand email and letter to the employer / HR department specifying exact unpaid wage period, salary slip figures, and statutory interest, granting 7 to 15 days to clear dues.
steps.action_hi: नियोक्ता या कंपनी के एचआर को ईमेल और डाक से स्पष्ट मांग पत्र (डिमांड लेटर) भेजें जिसमें बकाया महीनों का विवरण और भुगतान हेतु 7 से 15 दिन का समय दें।
documents_needed: Bank statements showing salary credit history

steps.action_en: File an online grievance on the Ministry of Labour's SAMADHAN portal (samadhan.labour.gov.in) or state labour department portal for industrial conciliation.
steps.action_hi: श्रम मंत्रालय के समाधान पोर्टल (samadhan.labour.gov.in) या राज्य श्रम विभाग के पोर्टल पर ऑनलाइन विवाद दर्ज करें।
steps.deadline_or_limitation: Anytime during or after dispute arises

steps.action_en: File a statutory claim application in Form A under Section 15(2) of the Payment of Wages Act or Section 20 of Minimum Wages Act before the designated Authority (Labour Officer / Assistant Labour Commissioner).
steps.action_hi: सक्षम श्रम अधिकारी (Authority under Payment of Wages Act) के समक्ष धारा 15(2) के तहत फॉर्म 'ए' में आवेदन प्रस्तुत करें।
steps.where: Office of the Assistant Labour Commissioner / Labour Court
steps.deadline_or_limitation: Must be presented within 12 months from the date on which deduction was made or wages fell due (delay can be condoned by Authority for sufficient cause)
documents_needed: Application in prescribed Form A (in duplicate)
Proof of employment, designation, and wage rate
Copy of demand notice served upon employer

steps.action_en: Participate in conciliation and inquiry proceedings before the Labour Authority. If the employer fails to appear or comply with order, the Authority issues a recovery certificate executed through the District Collector as arrears of land revenue.
steps.action_hi: श्रम अधिकारी के समक्ष सुनवाई में उपस्थित हों। आदेश का पालन न होने पर भू-राजस्व बकाया की भांति वसूली प्रमाण पत्र (रिकवरी सर्टिफिकेट) जारी किया जाता है।
steps.where: Labour Court / Office of District Collector

helplines.name: NALSA Legal Aid Helpline
helplines.description: Free legal aid for industrial workmen and labourers

free_legal_aid.eligible: Every industrial workman is expressly eligible for free legal aid under Section 12(e) of the Legal Services Authorities Act, 1987, without needing to prove low income.
free_legal_aid.how_to_apply: Approach the District Legal Services Authority (DLSA) or Labour Court Legal Services Clinic to obtain an appointed advocate for labour authority and court filings.
free_legal_aid.authority: DLSA / Labour Court Legal Services Committee

when_to_see_a_lawyer: If the employer disputes the existence of employee-employer relationship (claiming contract labour or freelance vendor)
When calculating complex retrenchment compensation, statutory bonus, or gratuity arrears under industrial dispute laws
If 12-month limitation under Section 15(2) has expired and strong grounds for condonation must be drafted
